title: Third US aircraft carrier brings thousands more troops to Middle East
summary_full: The US president oscillates between strike threats on Iran and insisting the war ‘militarily is effectively over’A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said in a social media post on Monday, making a dramatic show of military might as Donald Trump keeps his options open for next steps in the Iran war.The USS Theodore Roosevelt brings thousands of additional troops to the Middle East as Trump has oscillated between threatening additional large-scale strikes on Iran and insisting that the more than eight-month-old war “militarily is effectively over”.
